description.text:
Gem Pack (宝可梦卡牌 宝石包) Volume 2 came out on 16 May 2025 and is all about Eevee and its eight evolutions. As in Volume 1, every card is a holo, four to a pack, with the Gem Pack rarity marks ●, ◆, ★, ★★ and ★★★: each pack holds three ● or ◆ cards and one with stars.

Each of the nine Pokémon comes with more than one art and attack, and the same art in several finishes: patterns of its Energy symbol, of Poké Balls and others, a Master Ball pattern and a gold-foil Gem Pack logo. There are also holo Pokémon V and VMAX, some of the V with new art. Four art illustration cards by one artist, of Leafeon, Sylveon, Umbreon and Eevee, join in that order into one long picture of the Pokémon resting and playing in a forest. It also has holo Poké Ball, Level Ball, Quick Ball and Penny cards and basic Lightning, Psychic and Darkness Energy. The numbering follows Volume 1: four digits, the first two for the Pokémon, from 01 for Eevee to 09 for Sylveon (10 for Trainers and 11 for Energy), and the last two for the version.
